applicability.description: Count and deduplicate pre-parsed events under an explicitly supplied identity rule: either the complete line/string or a tuple of named event fields.
requires_markers: a field map with identity set to line or a list of field names
claims: Reports total event count, unique identity count, and removed duplicate count
Composes any explicitly named event fields into one identity
Preserves the first-seen semantic values of fields while ignoring duplicate occurrence order
Accepts an optional service tag in the field map without changing the identity rule

limitations: Input records must already be parsed; source-format parsing is adapter work
No case folding, normalization, fuzzy matching, time windows, or service-based grouping is performed
A composite identity follows the listed field names; omitted fields and explicit null values are not distinguished
Identity ordering is not semantically significant for equality
